expectNext: When I press Continue, I think it moves on to step 4 'Questions', which may ask a few follow-up questions. Then step 5 'Confirm' lets me look over everything. Then step 6 'Result' tells me whether my team can go ahead and what must be done first. Nothing is final until the Result. If any of my ticks or suggestions are missing, I expect Continue to refuse and tell me which ones are left.
ticksMean: 'I've checked this answer' means I read what the helper suggested and it matches what I meant. Until I tick it, or change the answer, it doesn't count and I can't continue. It does not mean the tool is approved. It only means that answer is mine and I stand behind it. If a suggestion is wrong, I must change it rather than tick it.
comment: The suggestions were mostly easy to check, and I changed the middle one because a person sends each reply. Not knowing which country the branch is in, what Ollama and alpha:7b are, or where "question 6" is made it feel less certain.
